name: Trigger spray bottle
summary: Squeezing the trigger forces a little liquid out of the nozzle as a mist, and letting go refills the pump through a tube that reaches the bottom of the bottle.

parts.name: Sprayer head
parts.role: The housing on top that holds the pump.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.role: The lever you squeeze with two fingers.

parts.name: Nozzle
parts.role: The small cap the spray comes out of; twisting it shuts it off.

parts.name: Dip tube
parts.role: A thin tube from the pump down to the bottom of the bottle.
